title: ComplexUi: the existing 83-control scene, clean and dirty frames
scenario: Samples/ComplexUi/ComplexUiScene.h: 16 cards (label, toggle, slider, progress bar), a Tree and a Grid over a 1,000-row model, absolute layout, offscreen EmbeddedHost, reduced motion; 20 warm-up frames, 40 clean frames, 40 dirty frames.
drawCalls: not counted: frame.drawCalls is 0 without the counting wrappers

phases.name: warm
phases.description: ComplexUiScene::Update(n): first-use resources and caches settle

phases.name: clean
phases.description: nothing changes: prepare and composite only

phases.name: dirty
phases.description: ComplexUiScene::Update(20 + n): 16 slider and progress values and the Grid's visible row change

videoMemory.reason: software adapter: rendering uses system memory, which privateBytes counts

memory.trackedLiveBytes: measured from the scene build onwards

G13.budget: idle native window <= 8 MB private above process entry at 1080p
G13.counter: private bytes after the last phase, shown, minus private bytes at process entry
local video memory usage of the process, hidden (a hidden embedded view is its minimized state)
G13.reason: software adapter: rendering uses system memory, which private bytes count

exception.finding: hiding releases the surface, yet the process's local video usage does not fall

G13.counter: tracked live C++ bytes after the build divided by the controls of the built tree (host attachment included)

exception.finding: Label alone is 448 B in Release; FX5 holds about 640 tracked bytes per control

G13.budget: <= 1 KB per visible single-line Grid cell
G13.counter: live heap bytes that rebuilding every Grid's cell layouts adds after hiding released them, per cell layout
G13.reason: software adapter: WARP's rasterizer threads allocate in the same heaps while the cells are rebuilt (hardware receipts measure this line)

exception.finding: a single-line cell keeps a whole DirectWrite layout between paints

G13.counter: EmbeddedStatistics::largestTextHistoryBytes after the last phase (TextField and ComboBox; RichTextEditor history is not counted)
G13.reason: the fixture has no TextField or ComboBox

timing.reason: timing comes only from performance-timing.ps1 on a hardware adapter in a quiet window (W0.2); counts and memory are recorded here

provenance.command: performance-fixtures.ps1 -Fixture FX5 -Variant default -Adapter Warp -FixtureHost embedded -Configuration 'Release' -Platform x64
